Platform / Forms

Forms and documentation

Services configure forms within Acutis to reflect their specific requirements — including mandatory regulatory forms and internal care forms.

← Platform

Typical form categories

Admission forms

  • Referral & pre-admission assessment
  • Consent to treatment
  • Risk assessment (initial)
  • Medication reconciliation

Ongoing care forms

  • Key worker session notes
  • Care plan review
  • Programme attendance
  • Risk review

Incident forms

  • Incident initial report
  • Incident review & closure
  • Serious incident escalation
  • Near-miss report

Discharge forms

  • Planned discharge summary
  • Unplanned departure record
  • Post-discharge referral
  • Final risk assessment

* This is an illustrative list. Each service configures its own forms according to its requirements.

Platform features

form

Form Management

A library of structured clinical and administrative forms — admission, assessment, consent, incident, discharge — completed in system and retained against the relevant record.

  • Pre-built form library for regulated care contexts
  • Digital signature capture
  • Mandatory field enforcement before submission
  • Version history and amendment tracking
